title: Tensura: Voice
description: This add-on adds Voice of the World’s animations and sound effects into the Tensura: Reincarnated mod.
body:
This addon adds Voice of the World sound effects and animations to the Tensura:Reincarnated mod.
it works with every extra unique ultimate skills.  also it says continueing when there is more than 1 skill acquired.
sounds and animation can be toggled in config.
